definition: A longer-term Vietnamese residence and re-entry document, available to holders of certain visa categories: including some Investor (DT) and Family (TT) visa tiers, that replaces the need to renew a visa repeatedly.
longform: Eligibility and length vary considerably by the route behind it: DT1 and DT2 investor visa holders are reported able to reach a card of up to 10 or 5 years respectively, while the smallest DT4 investment tier is reported as having no card option at all. The card is a separate application step after arrival, not an automatic upgrade from the visa.

sources.label: Vietnam National Electronic Visa system, evisa.gov.vn
